notes.m1_abbreviation_open_question: Line 3's blockquote ("Run M1 on `high` thinking effort") uses bare "M1" inside the M1 file itself. check_student_facing.md rule 2 states Prework and M1 files should use full forms ("Module 1") until M2 establishes the abbreviation. The identical thinking-effort blockquote pattern also appears bare-numbered in earn-the-trust.md ("Run M3") and plan-mode-done-right.md, so this reads as a deliberate corpus-wide convention for this specific operational-setting line (closer to a config label than narrative prose referencing another module), not a per-file slip. Scored PASS rather than REVISE because a single-file fix would only create an inconsistency with the sibling files' identical pattern; flagging here as a maintainer question about whether rule 2 should carve out this line shape explicitly.
